st: From Wes Anderson's Isle of Dogs to VanMoof, the new green revolution of the (e-)bike

sec.p: I don't know if you've noticed, but it seems the pandemic brought us more bicycles. At least in the Philippines. In fact, according to a World Bank survey, the bike was the only mode that saw its number of users grow.

You might think that urban redevelopment aimed at more sustainable mobility is only feasible on a small scale and in "blank slate" cities with little infrastructure tied to more traditional means of transport.
One issue with getting around on two wheels is safety, which scares many people and takes away their freedom to choose the bike.

sec.p: Remember VanMoof, the Dutch company that makes e-bikes with a "Tesla-style" design? I talked about it in 🎼 ff.5 Electrifying!.
